item.title: Gifts under $50 that people keep: 8 picks, who should skip each, and order-by dates
item.description: Eight useful gifts under $50 for 2026, led by the $39 ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2 thermometer that America's Test Kitchen named its Best Buy. Also an Owala bottle, an AirTag 2 for iPhone owners, a KONG, a ChomChom Roller, a mop, food containers and a heated throw. Each pick says who should skip it, what owners complain about and the Christmas shipping cutoffs. #giftsunder50 #giftguide #christmasgifts #amazonfinds

item.title: Dreo space heater review: a $50 heater for one room (running cost, safety, where it is cheapest)
item.description: Is the $50 Dreo oscillating heater worth it? About 27 cents an hour at full power, heats roughly 150 to 200 sq ft, with a thermostat and remote. We compare it with Vornado and Dyson, list the safety rules (wall outlet only, 3 feet clear) and show where it was cheapest. #spaceheater #homecomfort #wintercozy #amazonfinds

item.title: Black Friday 2026 tech and car deals: 12 picks and the price to wait for
